curation.policy: Only the five named CSV files are carried into the clean repository. Machine details, unrelated generated artifacts, and the legacy dirty-worktree inventory are deliberately excluded.

mingo2006_figure4.csv.source_kind: figure-extracted published vector plus NEGFPy historical calculations
mingo2006_figure4.csv.warning: The half-weight path is a sensitivity calculation, not a selected production normalization.

mingo2006_figure4_smooth_calculations.cs.source_kind: NEGFPy historical calculations on a 0--600 K display grid
mingo2006_figure4_smooth_calculations.cs.warning: This file contains no author raw data and no interacting Mingo Fig. 8 calculation.

wang2006_anharmonic_checkpoints.csv.source_kind: selected historical regression checkpoints against figure-extracted reference curves
wang2006_anharmonic_checkpoints.csv.warning: The O(T^2) and selective mean-field rows use separately named historical approximations and are not conserving production SCBA evidence.

wang2006_harmonic.csv.source_kind: figure-extracted published vector plus NEGFPy harmonic calculations
wang2006_harmonic.csv.warning: The published vector is not author raw numerical data.

wang2006_published_reference_curves.csv.source_kind: figure-extracted Wang harmonic, O(T^2), and selective-mean-field paths
wang2006_published_reference_curves.csv.warning: These curves are source-limited historical references, not exact same-input certification data.

mingo2006.title: Anharmonic phonon flow through molecular-sized junctions

wang2006.scope: harmonic and selected O(T^2)/selective-mean-field regression paths
wang2006.title: Nonequilibrium Green's function approach to mesoscopic thermal transport
